answer.rationale: Expiry in 14 days with no auto-renew plus a 94% loaded line and no buffer rules out switch (migration/onboarding risk) and deferral (possible supply gap). A plain renew is delivery-safe (c1) but does not address the 18% spend cut. Prior renewal benchmarking moved the incumbent on price and terms (c4) and multi-year volume pricing cut unit cost without narrowing scope (c6), so negotiate-at-renewal is the only single action that can reduce TCO without adding delivery risk. Verifying c4 because it is unclear whether past margin recovery approaches an 18% cut. Downstream interruption risk remains high if talks slip past expiry.
